title: The inducibility of 6-vertex graphs
summary: The inducibility constant $λ_{F}$ of a graph $F$ is the asymptotically maximum induced density of $F$ in a growing sequence of graphs. This paper systematically investigates the case when $F$ has 6 vertices (and there are 78 cases to consider up to isomorphism and complementation). We show that flag algebras can compute the sharp upper bound on $λ_F$ in 36 cases of which, as far as the authors know, 30 are new results.
